text:
rita: FYI i opened a tiny PR to clarify the docker quickstart env var names and to add a short migration note for folks using older examples. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4682
kai: thanks — what's changing exactly?
rita: we standardize on REDWOOD_TOKEN and switch curl/snippet examples to `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN`. previous docs had mixed REDWOOD_KEY / REDWOOD_API_KEY and an inconsistent curl header. trying to avoid more confused users in the onboarding workshop.
omar: quick grep shows a couple of leftover mentions in /docs/examples/hello-world/README.md and in an old tutorial under /docs/archive. i'll PR fixes if that's ok.
kai: good call. also saw a docker-compose example that set ENV REDWOOD_KEY="" but the run command in the same doc used -e REDWOOD_API_KEY. that's the kind of mismatch that trips people up.
rita: yep, updated the dockerfile + compose examples in the PR to use REDWOOD_TOKEN and fixed the run command.
ci-bot: CI started for PR #4682 (lint, link-check)
linter-bot: markdown lint: hard line break at line 42 in quickstart.md
kai: minor lint, i'll push a style fix.
omar: question: do we want to keep a compatibility snippet showing how to support older env vars?
rita: yes — added a short appendix showing a tiny wrapper in bash that reads REDWOOD_TOKEN || REDWOOD_API_KEY || REDWOOD_KEY and sets the header, plus a python snippet that checks os.environ for fallbacks.
kai: tested the updated examples locally — node/python/curl all work with REDWOOD_TOKEN set. docker-compose bring-up passes.
ci-bot: CI passed for #4682
rita: great — can someone merge? i'd like this on staging before monday's onboarding session.
omar: merging now.
ci-bot: PR #4682 merged by omar
kai: added a short note in /docs/whats-new.md about the env var harmonization and the fallback helper.
rita: thanks all — closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
